lifecycle_scenarios.name: pending_group
lifecycle_scenarios.through_ui: GM > Rolls > Group result > Start Rolls

lifecycle_scenarios.name: submitted_group
lifecycle_scenarios.through_ui: Each owning player > Rolls > Roll Now
lifecycle_scenarios.result: accepted native roll evidence; progress updates

lifecycle_scenarios.name: completed_group
lifecycle_scenarios.through_ui: GM > Rolls > End & Record or final player roll
lifecycle_scenarios.result: activeSession cleared; History records outcome and slot details

lifecycle_scenarios.name: public_roll_request
lifecycle_scenarios.through_ui: GM > Rolls > Individual rolls > Start Rolls
lifecycle_scenarios.result: one public skill roll per participant; no group averaging

privacy: Players never see the GM-only Party Stash in Utilities even if native Actor Observer permission is granted; no direct native transfer flow ships with this Alpha.
setup: fixtures/setup.mjs exports setup(); it creates real Foundry world documents only after an explicit GM console call.
reset: fixtures/setup.mjs exports reset(); it deletes only documents bearing fixtureId; optional deleteStash true with second confirmation.
